mark: A wooden tag with the leaf corner (two corners round, two square): the colour of the name stained into light wood with its grain, the letters in the italic note voice. A round mark is a tree ring, a ring inside a ring. The current mark in a list has the solid green ring, the corner glyph is a clay trig mark. See the grain on every size and that nothing is glowing.
stackbar: A wooden gauge routed into the page: the track is light wood with grain and a routed edge, each part is the same wood stained in its colour. The threshold is a clay trig point, a small triangle on the scale. Pointing at a part draws the dashed green blaze round it and blazes its legend row inside; legend names are italic notes, figures upright.
bullets: Rows that lead somewhere are blazed inside with the dashed green ring when pointed at (no wash, no underline); a figure past its threshold is a field note, a square italic tag on the warning or red pair; the detail line is italic. The bars are forest's wooden meter.
tick: A live number that counts has a growth ring drawn round it once, clockwise from the top on the growth curve, which then fades; the number itself never moves or swells. Change the number from the page and watch the ring.
uptime: Every period is a plank of the strip with the small leaf corner; the up planks carry wood grain; pointing blazes a plank with the dashed green ring and focus keeps the package's ring. The axis and the figures in the hover card are italic notes.
uptime-states: Loading shows forest's planted waiting pieces in the strip, empty and failed keep the strip's footprint; the failed summary is a field note (square, italic, on the red pair).
uptime-phone: At 390 px the strip scrolls sideways in its box, planks keep their leaf corner and the card opens under its plank.
inbox: Rows on the kraft ground with a short painted blaze on the start edge instead of a full bar (green for new, clay is never used for an action); notes (text and meta) are italic, titles upright; the next row has the moss wash. Buttons are forest's own.
backlog: The backlog list with painted blazes per state, group headings written as italic notes, done rows quieter by ink.
files: File rows with a lead, italic meta lines and the payload opened as a kraft note with the leaf corner.
appointments: Appointments: the next one on the moss wash with its blaze, dates and times in the note voice, past ones quiet.
checks: A check that passes with a reservation is a field note: a square italic tag on the warning pair; the fix written out has a clay blaze on its start edge and is italic. Failed checks keep the red field note.
sort: Forest's own data table with the page's external sort; the sorted header carries the table's arrow and the column that cannot be sorted now has none and no pointer.
kv: Labels are italic notes beside upright values; a ruled list is a trail of dashes in clay; a changed row has a clay dot after its label, a row that could not be read has a short painted red blaze on its start edge.
formrows: Settings rows: labels and the aside in the note voice, rules as clay dashes, a short clay blaze for a changed row and a red one for a failed row, the lock written in italic.
tiles: Choice tiles are kraft cards with the leaf corner. Pointing blazes a tile with the dashed green ring 2 px out, pressing closes the ring in solid, the chosen tile has the solid green edge over a moss wash, hints are italic. A disabled tile is dashed.
card-states: A card in four data states: loading lays the shared loading card with forest's planted row of trees, empty is the kraft note with the dashed edge, failed is the red field note with a normal Retry. The card keeps its height.
header: The header lead is a wooden tag, the title upright, the badge a field note, the freshness line in italic on its own line without jumping as it ticks.
art: Forest's own drawings: the field kit. A map sheet with the leaf corner, contour lines, a trig point, a trail that runs out, a tree with a crossed red blaze, two banks of a trail with a stream between, a grown tree with a flag at the trig point, a fastened gate. Each stroke grows up out of its own line on the growth curve, 80 ms apart, turning from autumn to green as it grows.
pipeline: Lanes are kraft plates with the leaf corner; each head is a wooden tag in the stage's stain; cards are kraft cards with the small leaf corner, blazed when pointed at and closed in solid when pressed; the open card has the solid green ring; shares and sub lines are italic notes.
pipeline-states: Loading lays the shared loading card with the planted row; failed is a kraft plate with the reason as a red field note and a normal Retry; the board keeps its size.
journey: One trail: reached steps are solid green nodes (or the step's colour) joined by a solid rule, steps to come are joined by a trail of dashes, the step it stands at has a dashed ring laid round it; names are italic notes, dates upright. A closed path ends in a red cross.
journey-states: Loading and empty journeys keep the stepper's height with forest's waiting pieces.
contact: The contact timeline: moments are nodes on the trail, planned ones dashed, square ones take the leaf corner, a cluster count is a field note, pointing blazes a node, a wait is a dashed trail line in the tone's colour.
contact-states: Loading, empty and failed contact timelines keep the timeline's footprint, loading uses the planted loading card, failed has a normal Retry.
secret: The hidden value lies in a routed slot of wood. The time left is a grove of whole trees planted along the line that withers back from its end as the time runs out. A read failure is a field note. Buttons are forest's own.
secret-phone: The same secret at 390 px: the buttons wrap under the slot and the grove line keeps its room.
manage: The dialog in sections: sections divided by a trail of dashes, a danger section with a short painted red blaze, dependents in a kraft note with the leaf corner.
confirm: The confirmation that depends on something: the dependents list in a kraft note with the leaf corner inside forest's dialog, which grows up out of its base on the growth curve.
type-dialog: The typed confirmation in its dialog: the loses note with an italic red field-note title, the name to type painted with a clay line under it, the field and the confirm button as forest's.
type-own: The same typed confirmation on the page, with the loses note as a kraft plate and the name painted with a clay underline.
type-phone: The typed confirmation at 390 px: notes and field stack and the long name wraps inside its mark.
disc: The timer is a cross-section of a trunk: annual rings on the face, clay marks on the rim, a knot for the hub and the time left as a green wedge. The names are italic notes.
disc-states: Paused is quieter; when time is up a growth ring is drawn round the disc three times on the growth curve, and the status line says so.
disc-phone: The trunk disc at 390 px: it scales with the box and the buttons stay a normal size.
countdown: The countdown is a kraft plate with the leaf corner; the digits are upright, the name and status line italic notes.
countdown-states: Paused greys the digits; when ended a growth ring is drawn round the plate three times; nothing else moves.
range: The preset track and Custom are forest's; the custom window in force wears the solid green ring of a pick; the line under it is an italic note.
range-states: The wrong-range panel: the popover's own opaque plate under its anchor, invalid fields dashed red, a red sentence saying why.
wheel: A cross-section of a trunk: the hub is heartwood with its tree rings, the pointer is a clay trig mark, wedges are soft washes between drawn lines with italic labels. It spins up out of nothing on the growth curve and settles; the caption is an italic note.
cook: Cook mode: what the step needs is a kraft note with the leaf corner, its title and the names in the note voice; each step grows up out of its own line (the package's arrival in forest).
timers: Each timer is a kraft card with the leaf corner, the time upright and the state an italic note; the bar is the planted row of trees; when a timer rings a growth ring is drawn round the card three times.
quantity: The number lies in a routed slot of wood; the minus and plus are forest's own buttons; the unit is an italic note.
checklist: Rows are blazed inside with the dashed green ring when pointed at (no wash), a ticked item is struck through in clay and goes quiet, rules are trails of clay dashes, counts are italic notes.
tri: The three-way chips: a chip that is in is green on the leaf corner, a chip that is out is a dashed outline with its word struck through and a red node; pointing blazes a chip with the dashed ring and pressing closes it in solid.
code: The code block is a kraft plate with the leaf corner; the head and the foot are cut from the body by a trail of clay dashes; meta and line numbers are italic notes; the text itself sits on plain ground.
command: The command block: a kraft plate with the leaf corner, the shell name on a small wooden tag, prompts in clay, the head and the place line cut by dashes, the place in italics.
command-long: A long command in the same plate: wrapping under the prompt with the hanging indent or scrolling in its box with the faded edge.
command-phone: The command block at 390 px, head on one line, code wrapped, nothing touching the edge.
compare: The comparison sits in a kraft frame with the leaf corner; the divider is a trail of green dashes with a round handle, blazed with the dashed ring when pointed at and closed in solid when pressed; the labels are square italic field notes.
compare-live: Loading lays the shared loading card with the planted row over the frame; a failed image says so in its pane with a normal Retry; the divider glides on the growth curve.
